A1.justification: Both PDFs describe AsymLoc and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables, references, and Appendix A.1–A.6. The complete documents support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original localization and matching experiments in Table 1, loss ablations in Table 2, and additional architecture, baseline, latency, and XFeat experiments in the appendix.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results, including the main benchmark comparisons and all appendix experiments.

M1.justification: The teacher–student pipeline, geometric matching objective, joint detector–descriptor distillation, architectures, and inference procedure remain unchanged. Equations 1–13 are retained.

E1.justification: Both versions retain COCO and MegaDepth training coverage and HPatches, ScanNet, IMC2022, Aachen, and MegaDepth-1500 evaluations. The revised IMC2022 description concerns its evaluation protocol; it does not establish newly evaluated task or domain coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the corresponding main and appendix experiments. Standard, naive distillation, AML, RKD, CSD, D3Still, the teacher models, LoFTR, and SuperPoint+LightGlue retain their reported roles.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 changes IMC2022 from a claimed official evaluation protocol to evaluation on random subsets of its training split; Appendix A.3 explicitly states that this differs from the official benchmark. This substantially revises the reported testing protocol. MLA is also relabeled mAA, but the PDFs do not establish rerunning experiments or changing the metric computation.

E4.justification: The loss and temperature ablations, model-size and residual-connection analyses, additional baseline comparisons, matching visualization, and latency analysis are retained. No new robustness test, case study, or analytical result is introduced.

E5.justification: v2 newly states that IMC2022 results are averaged over subsets selected with different seeds. This adds seed and aggregation information without establishing additional runs. Neither version supplies the seed count, confidence intervals, or variability estimates for these results.

E6.justification: Numerical entries in Tables 1–8 and the plotted results remain unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains IMC2022 values of 0.51 for the 0.13M AsymLoc student and 0.45 for Standard. The revised protocol description and metric labels do not demonstrate changed performance.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulation, definitions, and loss equations are unchanged, including the equations repeated in Appendix A.1. No theorem, proof, assumption, or derivation is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contributions, and conclusion retain the same novelty and efficiency–accuracy claims: asymmetric localization through joint detector–descriptor distillation enables compact students to approach teacher performance.

C2.justification: Appendix A.3 newly acknowledges that IMC2022 results come from a nonofficial evaluation and explains that official Kaggle submissions were considered prohibitively time-consuming. This qualifies the benchmark status of the evidence; other interpretations and applicability claims remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The expanded Appendix A.3 documents the IMC2022 subset evaluation and explicitly states that none of the models were trained on IMC2022. This improves evaluation documentation, although subset sizes and exact sampling details remain unspecified. Existing implementation and hardware details are retained.

R1.justification: The cited works and related-work positioning remain unchanged. The added citation accompanying mAA refers to the already cited IMC2022 reference, rather than introducing new literature.

P1.justification: v2 rewrites the IMC2022 dataset paragraph, updates metric terminology, adds an explanatory appendix paragraph, and renames A.3 from 'Training Details' to 'Training and Evaluation Details.' The broader narrative and section organization remain intact.

P2.justification: Table 1 changes its IMC2022 header from 'Mean Loc.' to 'Mean Avg.' Figure 5 updates the corresponding axes and caption to mAA and shortens 'Teacher (LocBase)' to 'Teacher,' retaining the same curves. Text, tables, and figures undergo limited layout reflow.

improvement.justification: v2 improves transparency by replacing the official-protocol claim with an explicit account of the custom IMC2022 evaluation, documenting seed averaging and training exclusion, and consistently labeling mAA. These corrections help readers assess the evidence without changing the scientific contribution or results. The benefit remains limited because subset sizes, seed counts, and uncertainty estimates are still missing.
